g.text: Effect of causal education under the 8-second framing
Every plotted difference = 8 s + causal education minus 8 s + control reading.
H3: For each of 8 matched scenario pairs: (order at low outstanding quantity − order at high outstanding quantity) / (high − low outstanding quantity). Average the 8
H4a: For each role, sum the squared deviations of its 24 orders from its own mean, divide by 23, then average the 4 role variances.
H4b: Within each chain, divide each role's 24-week sample order variance by the 24-week sample variance of final-consumer demand; average the 4 ratios. Then average
chains. Do not divide pooled condition means.
Zero = equal outcomes. Positive = the first named condition is higher. Negative = it is lower.
Diamond: mean of 10 paired differences. Bar: pointwise 95% paired-block bootstrap interval. Fictional framing; no model timer.
